verses.gurmukhi: ੧੧ : ਬੁਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਵਿਖੇ
verses.translit_en: 11 : bure naal bhalaa karan dhe vikhe

en.bdb: Tree is there in the world and keeps its head downward.
It stands steadfast and maintains its head low.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲ ਸਫਲੁ ਵਟ ਸਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: hoi sufal fal safal vaT sahaiaa|

en.bdb: Then becoming full of fruits it bears the stone-blows.
Further it gets sawed and causes to make ship.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਵਾਟ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paanee dhe sir vaaT raahu chalaiaa|

en.bdb: Now it moves on the head of water.
Having borne iron-saw upon head, it carries the same iron (used in ship making) across the water.
